svg.title: Open Volume comparison
svg.desc: Black board, white section linework, and translucent gold #D6AD4F interstitial raster cells. Cells are not merged and are not claimed as occupiable space. Source OBJ geometry was not modified.

g.text: Gold marks interstitial raster cells, not occupiable space.
Gold is not the full Open Volume score.
Architectural Open Space 35%. Permeability 30%. Interstitial Space 25%. Low Mass 10%.
Shared architectural scale. Rank is not circulation feasibility.
